newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Jackson County, W. Va..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Jackson County, W. Va..

text.p: 6.5% Refunding Pollution Control Revenue Bonds Series 1978

Maturity Date: March 1, 2008, CUSIP Number: 468151AA3 NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that pursuant to the provisions of Section 3.02 of the Trust Indenture dated as of March 1, 1978 between The County Commission of Jackson County, West Virginia and Mellon Bank, N.A. (Paying Agent''), $200,000 principal amount of the Bonds has been called for early redemption on March 1, 1997 at a redemption price of 100% plus accrued interest to the redemption date.
The bonds selected for redemption March 1, 1997 bear the distinctive numbers listed:

Some bonds have been called in part and, upon surrender for payment, a new certificate for the remainder will be issued. All interest on the called Bonds shall cease to accrue on and after March 1, 1997. The Bonds must be surrendered for payment and redemption for delivery to the following address.

NOTICE: In compliance with the Interest and Dividend Tax Compliance Act of 1983 and Broker Reporting Requirements, the redeeming institution is required to withhold 31% of the principal amount redeemed unless they are provided with your social security number or federal employer identification number, properly certified.

The CUSIP number is included solely for the convenience of the Bondholders. Neither the Issuer nor the Trustee shall be responsible for the selection or the use of the CUSIP number, nor is any representation made as to its correctness on the securities or as indicated on any redemption notice.
